h3zero.full_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is a grey untextured 3D blockout of this exact shot. It is the sole authority for camera path, timing, framing, and the position and scale of every object. Its colours and materials carry no information.
<Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3> are the sole authority for appearance: colour, light, material, and rendering style.

summary:
Reproduce the camera move and blocking of <Video 1> exactly, rendered in the look of <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3>.

retention_analysis:
From <Video 1>: camera trajectory, speed, roll, shot scale, and where each object sits in frame at each moment.
From <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3>: colourful comic-book illustration, golden-hour amber light, haze, saturated ink-like shading.
Invented, because the blockout contains nothing above the roofline: a wide bay at sunset, a long suspension bridge in silhouette, and distant towers in orange light.

detailed_description:
A busy city street at golden hour, shot on a 20mm lens.
At 00:00.000 the camera is low in the street canyon, buildings close on both sides, the low sun down the street ahead.
At 00:01.500 it passes a car on its left, banked into the weave.
At 00:03.000 it passes cars on its right, banked the other way.
At 00:04.100 it reaches the building closing the street and starts up its facade.
At 00:05.900 it is climbing, window rows sliding down past frame, still below the roof.
At 00:06.600 it crests the parapet; a rooftop water tank on a steel frame stands close on the right, filling a third of the frame.
At 00:07.300 it tilts up off the rooftop.
At 00:10.000 the bay, the suspension bridge, and the distant skyline fill the frame in orange light.

overall_soundscape:
City street ambience: traffic, tyres on asphalt, distant horns, and wind rising as the camera climbs.

non_diegetic_music:
None.

generation.full_prompt:
Maintain the camera movement, composition, and object positions from Video 1.
Video 1 is only a guide for movement and composition. Don't rely on the appearance of the objects or the reference video. The appearance is determined solely by the reference images.
Use Image 1, Image 2, and Image 3 as visual style guides.

These colorful, comic-book-style frames, shot on 20mm anamorphic film, depict a busy city street at golden hour. The low sun glides down the street ahead, the warm amber light casting long shadows and highlights through the haze and rising dust. Above the rooftops, a view opens onto a wide bay at sunset, the silhouette of a long suspension bridge, and distant towers bathed in orange light.
